weekOverWeekComparison.reason: Insufficient data for reliable comparison: public Play Store scraper sample does not have continuous, daily uniform cohort density.

proposedAlertThresholds.note: The following thresholds are labeled as PROPOSED for operational triage and are not hardcoded enterprise SLAs.
proposedAlertThresholds.criticalNegativeSpike: >= 5.0% increase in 1–2★ review share across 30 days
proposedAlertThresholds.ratingDropWarning: >= 0.20 drop in monthly average Play Store rating
proposedAlertThresholds.acuteCrashAlert: >= 3 launch crash reviews reported within any 48-hour window
